summary_bullets: Changed /design and /implement final-summary orchestrator contracts from cost-line-only emission to verbatim full-body emission gated on a non-empty persisted summary file.
Updated /implement Step 17/18 sentinel mechanics to use summary body presence and a Step 18 pre-render body snapshot compared with cmp -s.
Aligned sibling docs, lint catalog, regression harness pins, and CHANGELOG for the full-block top-chat visibility contract.
commit_message:
Surface final summaries at top chat (#2970)

Replace the /design and /implement cost-line-only orchestrator exception with a verbatim full-body summary emission contract gated on non-empty persisted summary files. Update /implement Step 17/18 sentinels to track body emission and compare Step 18 renders against a pre-render snapshot. Align sibling docs, lint catalog, harness pins, and changelog coverage.
